description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the Edit View of SalesOrder module in a CRM system, handling data retrieval, form setup, and display logic for creating or editing sales orders, including quote conversion and related entity management.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, providing instance retrieval.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper for CRM views.

classes.name: Quotes

classes.name: Accounts
classes.description: Model class for Accounts entity, handling account data retrieval.
